'''Dogah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] Grappler [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] active during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Secrets" /> In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he, with fellow Imperials [[Ziliss]] and [[Kodo (sergeant)|Kodo]], fought [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], [[Arn Peralun]], and [[Aryn Leneer]] when they arrived at the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]] to investigate the whereabouts of [[Darth Malgus]]. Dogah, however, perished in the encounter along with his Imperial companions.<ref name="Secrets" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dogah appears as a boss in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion. He is only seen in the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] plotline, given that his role is replaced by grappler [[Osonu]] in the Imperial plotline.<ref name="Secrets" />
